title: Intervención y Guerra Fría
goal: Read how the Central American conflicts became Cold War proxy wars -- US funding of the Contras, Congress's limit on aid, Cuban and Soviet support, and a UN-backed commission's findings on Guatemala.
grammar: A instancias de: señalar quién impulsó una acción

items: Explain how the US began funding, training and arming the Contras at Reagan's urging.
Explain how officials sought alternative ways to fund the Contras, and how Congress limited aid.
State what the UN-backed commission concluded about the victims and the perpetrators.
Describe Cuban and Soviet military support and the interests behind it.
Use a instancias de to name who pushed for an action.
